findings.title: GoalStore uses std::sync::Mutex directly instead of crate::sync_primitives::Mutex (R8 violation)
findings.description: src/goal/store.rs:113,145,149 import std::sync::Mutex and std::sync::MutexGuard directly, violating Aleph invariant R8. The sibling looping module (src/looping/mod.rs:14) imports Mutex from crate::sync_primitives. The two parallel subsystems use two different conventions, and the goal-side direct std::sync::Mutex cannot be swapped for loom.
findings.trigger: Reviewer scan for sync-primitive imports across the goal subsystem.
findings.suggested_fix: Mechanical substitution: std::sync::Mutex → crate::sync_primitives::Mutex (and MutexGuard accordingly). Zero-cost at runtime because the re-exports ARE std::sync.

findings.title: pause_all_owned_by reads now_ms from SystemTime inside the lock; inconsistent with sibling helpers
findings.description: Every other mutating helper on GoalStore (block_if_active, pause_if_active, park_if_active, etc.) takes now_ms: u64 as a parameter from the caller so the test harness can drive a deterministic clock. pause_all_owned_by is the sole exception.
findings.trigger: Test of pause_all_owned_by that asserts note includes a now_ms value.
findings.suggested_fix: Take now_ms: u64 as a parameter and have the single external caller in src/gateway/handlers/users.rs supply it.
findings.deferred_reason: Single-call-site change; cosmetic only — the test gap is more impactful than the function signature inconsistency.

findings.title: pause_all_active has no direct unit test (only the owned_by variant does)
findings.description: pause_all_active is the kill-switch for 'quiet everything' across every session — its sibling pause_all_owned_by has three dedicated tests, pause_all_active itself has none.
findings.trigger: Any future refactor of pause_all_active that changes its terminal status or barrier cleanup.
findings.suggested_fix: Add pause_all_active_pauses_only_active_goals_and_drops_their_wait_barriers test alongside the existing pause_all_owned_by_* tests.
findings.deferred_reason: Test coverage gap; no current defect. Documented in the comment and easy to add later.

findings.title: GoalWakeService::claim_and_spawn passes None for workspace on every wake-side claim (informational)
findings.description: Intended behaviour: the stored workspace is preserved across wake claims. Documented and tested. No bug.
findings.deferred_reason: Informational only — wiring is verified intact.

notes: Module is otherwise well-defended: every state transition is CAS'd, every claim is atomic under a single conn lock, every cleanup is co-located with its transition, every public store method has at least one external caller. Only the sync primitives convention gap warranted a fix; the rest are hygiene / test coverage.
